rust.name: src/main.rs:214:88: replace || with && in run
rust.why: A ratchet that records growth and picked mutants together can lose its author when it omits --no-mutants. The growth test writes only a growth record.

rust.name: src/growth.rs:74:40: replace += with *= in Records::of
rust.why: The report test asserts an as-is count and never tallies a valid cut verdict, so the cut count can stay at zero.

rust.name: src/growth.rs:161:58: replace && with || in one_line
rust.why: Blank and multiline growth fields pass this check, while the test supplies only nonblank single-line values.

rust.name: src/tasks.rs:214:33: delete - in justify_growth
rust.why: The task test has one changed file, so it cannot detect a reversal of the largest-growth-first order.

rust.name: src/ratchet.rs:515:64: replace > with >= in growth_violation
rust.why: A suite with offsetting gains and losses would be listed as growing. The violation test checks only a suite with positive net growth.
